key_idea: Distance <= 3 can be checked by naively climbing the deeper endpoint toward the LCA for at most 3 steps using parent and depth arrays.
sketch: BFS from node 1 to get parent and depth (iterative, a path tree would overflow recursion). For each adjacent pair in the permutation, repeatedly move the deeper node to its parent, counting steps, stopping after more than 3 steps or when the nodes meet; the pair is valid iff they meet within 3 moves. O(n) per test, sum n <= 1e5. Pitfall: many test cases, so allocate per test proportional to n.
